issue_context.title: Consume PosixSignal in Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Systemd's SystemdLifetime
issue_context.body:
Same change as https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/55417, but we should make it for Systemd.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d38a5396608240a6426668238e06056c69b85c50/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Systemd/src/SystemdLifetime.cs#L48-L78

We should also figure out how to add real tests, as I don't believe there are any tests for this library, yet. The only test we have:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d38a5396608240a6426668238e06056c69b85c50/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Systemd/tests/UseSystemdTests.cs#L13-L24

tests that Systemd is "off" when not in a systemd service.
